flawed_step: Lines 0035–0036 and 0060 incorrectly claim that every nonempty C_ij is itself a minimal cut.
counterexample: Let G be the 4-cycle a-b-c-d-a, with S={a,c} and T={b,d}. Both G[S] and G[T] consist of two isolated components. For Si={a} and Tj={b}, C_ij={ab}. But {ab} is not a cut-set: deleting edge ab leaves the connected path a-d-c-b. Thus this nonempty C_ij is not a cut, let alone a minimal cut.
assessment_summary: The proposed component-pair decomposition does partition the original cut, but its pieces need not be cuts. The explicit 4-cycle example refutes the key claim on which the conclusion relies.
